anchor: 從此西北行二百里，至羯若鞠闍國。
end_anchor: 讀《佛使毘婆沙》、《日胄毘婆沙》訖。
note: Same 200 li NW from Kapitha. The Life summarises Harṣa's accession (murder of his brother by Śaśāṅka) and adds that Xuanzang stayed three months at the Bhadra-vihāra (跋達邏毘訶羅寺) reading Vibhāṣās with Vīryasena. The Kanauj (曲女城) assembly of fasc. 5 is not included.

anchor: 自此東南行六百餘里，渡殑伽河，南至阿踰陀國
note: Same route (600 li SE, crossing the Ganges). Asaṅga's ascent to Tuṣita and the list of Asaṅga/Vasubandhu works are expanded.

anchor: 法師自阿踰陀國禮聖跡，順殑伽河
note: Event the Xiyu ji lacks: about 100 li downstream from Ayodhyā, in the aśoka forests, Durgā-worshipping river pirates seize the boat and prepare to sacrifice Xuanzang; a black storm makes them repent and take the five precepts. Ayamukha itself is only named (300 li E, across the Ganges, as in the Xiyu ji).

anchor: 從此東南行七百餘里，渡殑伽河南、閻牟那河北
note: Same 700 li SE. Includes the stūpa in the campaka grove, Deva's monastery, and the great alms field.

anchor: 大城東兩河交處，其西有墠
note: Harṣa's quinquennial 75-day distribution. In fasc. 5 Xuanzang attends Harṣa's sixth great alms-giving here (not included).

anchor: 從此西南入大林，多逢惡獸、野象。
end_anchor: 是無著菩薩作《顯揚論》處。
note: Same 500 li SW through the forest. Udayana's sandalwood image described; Xuanzang returns here with Harṣa's escort in fasc. 5 ("城南劬師羅長者施佛園處").

anchor: 城南有故宅，是瞿史羅長者故居也。
end_anchor: 是無著菩薩作《顯揚論》處。
note: Name form 瞿史羅 (Xiyu ji 具史羅); includes Vasubandhu's Vijñaptimātra pavilion and Asaṅga's site.

anchor: 從此東行五百餘里，至鞞索迦國。
note: Different route: Life 500 li E from Kauśāmbī; Xiyu ji goes via Kāśapura and then 170–180 li N. Adds the Devaśarman/Gopa controversy and Dharmapāla's victory; the tooth-stick tree.

anchor: 從此東北行五百餘里，至室羅伐悉底國。
end_anchor: 是舍利子與外道論議處。
note: Same 500 li NE. The Kāśyapa-city site (06.01.14) follows separately.

anchor: 城南五六里有逝多林。
end_anchor: 是舍利子與外道論議處。
note: Includes the three pits and the shadow-covered temple.

anchor: 大城西北六十餘里有故城
從此東南行八百餘里，至劫比羅伐窣堵國。
note: Distance differs: Life 800 li SE from Śrāvastī, Xiyu ji 500 li. Adds the Sthavira vs. other schools' dates for the conception. Lumbinī and the past-Buddha cities are absent from the Life.
The Life names only the contest sites "於城左右", not the arrow spring.
Lumbinī is not mentioned in the Life.

anchor: 從此東行荒林五百餘里，至藍摩國。
note: Distance differs: Life 500 li E through waste forest, Xiyu ji 200 li.

anchor: 沙彌伽藍東大林中行百餘里
出此林已，至拘尸那揭羅國。
河側不遠至娑羅林
note: Same dating traditions for the Nirvāṇa as the Xiyu ji.

anchor: 城西北三四里，渡阿恃多伐底河。
end_anchor: 城西北三四里，渡阿恃多伐底河。

anchor: 又如來坐金棺為母說法
note: Only named in passing ("香木焚身").

anchor: 從此復大林中經五百餘里，至婆羅痆斯國。
note: Same 500 li through forest. Life: 2000+ monks, Sarvāstivāda.

anchor: 渡婆羅痆斯河東北行十餘里，至鹿野伽藍
精舍東南有石窣堵波，無憂王所建
其側有梅怛麗菩薩受記處。
end_anchor: 其側有梅怛麗菩薩受記處。
note: Only named in passing; name form 梅怛麗.

anchor: 釋迦受記南，有過去四佛經行處

note: The Life has only "又度憍陳如等五人處" (conversion of the five), not the welcome stūpa.

anchor: 從此順殑伽河流東行三百餘里，至戰主國。
end_anchor: 從此順殑伽河流東行三百餘里，至戰主國。
note: Only named in passing.

anchor: 從此東北渡殑伽河行百四五十里，至吠舍釐國。
note: Same 140–150 li NE.

anchor: 宮城西北五六里有一伽藍
end_anchor: 是佛昔說《毘摩羅詰經》處。

anchor: 次東北三四里有窣堵波，是毘摩羅詰故宅
note: Adds the stone chamber where Vimalakīrti preached in sickness.

anchor: 次北三四里有窣堵波，是佛將往拘尸那國
note: Name form 菴摩羅女.

anchor: 從吠舍釐南境去殑伽河百餘里，到吠多補羅城
note: Name form 吠多補羅城 (a city, not a monastery); event the Xiyu ji lacks: Xuanzang obtains the Bodhisattvapiṭaka sūtra here.

anchor: 又南渡殑伽河，至摩揭陀國。
note: Crossing the Ganges straight from the Vaiśālī area (no Vṛji or Nepal). Life: 50+ monasteries, 10,000+ monks.

anchor: 河南有故城，周七十餘里
end_anchor: 法師在小城停七日，巡禮聖迹。
note: Xuanzang spends seven days in the small city.

anchor: 地獄南有窣堵波，即八萬四千之一也。
精舍北有石柱，高三十餘尺
故城東南有屈吒阿濫摩僧伽藍故基
note: Name form 屈吒阿濫摩.

anchor: 又西南行六七由旬，至低羅磔迦寺。
note: Name form 低羅磔迦; Life gives 6–7 yojanas SW from Pāṭaliputra (Xiyu ji 100 li SW of an old monastery). On a later visit (fasc. 4) Xuanzang spends two months here with Prajñābhadra, "3 yojanas W of Nālandā".

anchor: 摩揭陀國前正覺山龍窟留影金佛像一軀
note: Only named in passing (fasc. 6): among the images brought to Chang'an, a gold copy of the shadow image in the dragon cave of Prāgbodhi.

anchor: 從此又南行百餘里，到菩提樹。
note: Life goes 100+ li S from Tilaḍhaka direct to the tree (Xiyu ji via the great mountain, Gayā and Prāgbodhi). Xuanzang arrives at the end of the rains, weeps at the tree, and stays 8–9 days.

anchor: 法師至，禮菩提樹及慈氏菩薩所作成道時像
note: The enlightenment image "made by Maitreya" is the image of the vihāra east of the tree in the Xiyu ji.

anchor: 西國法以此月菩提寺出佛舍利
note: Event the Xiyu ji lacks (fasc. 4): at the New-Year relic display of the 菩提寺 Xuanzang and Jayasena see the relic stūpa blaze with light at night.

anchor: 從此復往杖林山居士勝軍論師所。
note: Staff-forest mountain (杖林山). Xuanzang studies two years with the layman Jayasena (biography given); the following dream of Nālandā's ruin and Harṣa's death is not included.

anchor: 法師於那爛陀寺安置已，向王舍城觀禮聖迹。
note: Name form 矩奢揭羅補羅城. Life: circuit 150+ li, inner city 30+ li.

anchor: 次火坑東北山城之曲有窣堵波
宮城東北行十四五里，至姞栗陀羅矩吒山。
山城北門行一里餘，至迦蘭陀竹園
竹園東有窣堵波，阿闍多設咄路王之所建。
竹園西南行五六里，山側有別竹林
note: Long narrative of Ānanda's exclusion and the recitation.

anchor: 又此西二十里有窣堵波，無憂王所建
note: Life: 20 li W of the first-council cave; five piṭakas.

anchor: 次東北三四里至曷羅闍姞利呬多城。
note: Name form 曷羅闍姞利呬多城.

anchor: 那爛陀寺者，此云施無厭寺。
note: Description only. Before it the Life narrates the arrival (four elders sent from Nālandā, reception by 200 monks and 1000 patrons), Śīlabhadra's dream of the three bodhisattvas foretelling a Chinese monk, and Xuanzang's allowance; after it the Rājagṛha circuit and five years of study.

anchor: 那爛陀寺西北有大精舍
note: Bālāditya's great vihāra, the seven-day preaching stūpa, Harṣa's brass vihāra and Pūrṇavarman's copper Buddha. Life: NW of the monastery.

anchor: 行可七踰繕那至寺莊。
end_anchor: 莊是尊者目連本生之村。
note: Maudgalyāyana's village is the monastery's estate where Xuanzang is received, "7 yojanas" from Bodhgayā.

anchor: 又東行三十餘里，至因陀羅勢羅窶訶山。
note: Haṃsa stūpa story as in the Xiyu ji.

anchor: 在路至迦布德伽藍。
note: Only named in passing, on the way to Hiraṇyaparvata after five years at Nālandā.

anchor: 伽藍南二三里有孤山
end_anchor: 願憶今日因緣先相度耳。
note: Event the Xiyu ji lacks: Xuanzang throws flower garlands at the Avalokiteśvara image with three vows (safe return, rebirth in Tuṣita, Buddha-nature), and all catch.
